identityRegistryFunctions.eventRegistered: event Registered(uint256 indexed agentId, string agentURI, address indexed owner)
identityRegistryFunctions.getMetadata: getMetadata(uint256 agentId, string metadataKey) external view returns (bytes)
identityRegistryFunctions.register(): register() external returns (uint256 agentId) — mints the agent NFT to msg.sender, sets agentWallet = msg.sender, agentURI empty
identityRegistryFunctions.register(string): register(string agentURI) external returns (uint256 agentId) — same + sets tokenURI

identityRegistryFunctions.setAgentWallet: setAgentWallet(uint256 agentId, address newWallet, uint256 deadline, bytes signature) external — EIP-712, see eip712 below
identityRegistryFunctions.setMetadata: setMetadata(uint256 agentId, string metadataKey, bytes metadataValue) external — only owner/operator; "agentWallet" key reserved
identityRegistryFunctions.tokenURI: tokenURI(uint256 tokenId) external view returns (string) — the agentURI metadata JSON

project: Rupiah Relay — Celo Agents Open for Business
registrationSteps: 1. Fund the AGENT EOA (0xa9cB01C54930511202fd75734bcdDe8FbE9B2453) with CELO for gas — Ivan's money decision.
2. Host the agent metadata JSON at a public URL (agentURI) — template in agentURI.metadata below. Suggested host: the repo's GitHub Pages / web/ status page.
3. Run: cd agent && AGENT_URI=<url> node src/register-8004.js — calls register(agentURI) FROM the agent EOA. The NFT is owned by the agent EOA and agentWallet is set to the agent EOA automatically.
4. Record the agentId from the Registered event (the script writes it back into this file) and verify on https://8004scan.io.
5. If the URI changes later: setAgentURI(agentId, newURI) from the agent EOA.
DO NOT register from the RupiahRelay contract — register() sets agentWallet = msg.sender, and the relay cannot sign. The relay address belongs in metadata (key "relay"), not as the agent wallet.
